s.t: The Sr Product Owner plays a critical role in ensuring that a product or feature is developed with a focus on delivering value to the customer and the business. They act as a voice for the customer and are responsible for making key product-related decisions throughout the development process, including identifying opportunities to incorporate emerging technologies, such as AI-enabled capabilities, where they can improve user experience, workflow efficiency, and business outcomes.

Product Vision & Stakeholder Alignment
Translation: Work with stakeholders to translate future vision and requirements into clearly broken-down epics and stories; ensure all team members understand and align with product goals, including consideration of emerging technologies where appropriate.
Stakeholder Communication: Act as the primary point of contact between the development team and stakeholders; communicate progress, changes, and updates regularly.
Team Enabler: Work with one or more Agile Development Teams and act as a central reference and information source, guiding system/product functionality decisions.
Entrepreneurial Spirit: Demonstrate a track record of delivering results in fast-moving, demanding environments.
Backlog Ownership & Prioritization
Prioritization: Create and maintain the product backlog; prioritize features, user stories, and tasks based on business value, customer needs, market trends, and strategic opportunities.
Backlog Management: Continuously groom and refine the backlog based on feedback, changing priorities, and new insights.
Feedback Integration: Gather and incorporate feedback from stakeholders and end-users into the backlog; adjust as necessary.

User Story Development: Break down high-level requirements into detailed, implementable user stories that meet strong Agile standards and support effective workflows, automation, and decision support where applicable.
Acceptance Criteria: Define clear acceptance criteria so the team understands what constitutes “done” for each feature.
UI/UX Alignment: Partner with UX to ensure backlog items have wireframes and UI designs ready for sprint planning; provide design feedback, participate in design sprints, and support user acceptance testing.
Planning, Delivery & Risk
Sprint Planning: Participate in sprint planning to select stories and tasks; ensure the team has a clear understanding of work scope.
Release Planning: Collaborate with the team and stakeholders to plan and prioritize releases aligned with market needs and business goals.
Quality Assurance: Ensure the product meets quality standards by accepting or rejecting work during sprint reviews.
Risk Management: Identify and mitigate delivery risks; partner with the release manager on timelines, tough conversations, mitigation strategies, and transparent escalation to leadership.
Business Outcomes & Data
Business Case Support: Assist in developing and presenting business cases for new features and initiatives; ensure alignment with strategic goals and stakeholder expectations.
Data-Driven: Define KPIs and measures for features and capabilities to track impact and inform decisions.

4-7 years of relevant work experience
Experience with Product and Development tools such as ADO, Jira or other similar tools.
Healthcare and technical expertise are highly preferred, including experience with data, API integrations, and interoperability standards such as HL7 and FHIR.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to use data and metrics to back up assumptions, evaluate outcomes, and assess opportunities related to emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities, where applicable.
Leadership and decision-making skills
Excellent communication and presentation abilities
Understanding of the industry, market trends, and customer needs

Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, UI/UX, Product Management, leadership, and internal and external stakeholders.

Manage a high-performing cross-functional product team that includes engineering, design, data, marketing, legal, and customer support to implement and build new features

· (25%) Platform Administration and Operational Excellence: Lead hands-on administration of enterprise AI platforms, including workspace configuration, access provisioning, license and permission management, SSO/RBAC coordination, user lifecycle processes, API access intake, governance checks, and operational documentation. Identify and implement opportunities to automate, standardize, and streamline recurring workflows.
· (20%) Product Operations and Global Delivery Management: Provide product direction, priorities, requirements, user stories, and success criteria to India-based operations and execution teams. Coordinate sprint planning, backlog refinement, cross-time-zone handoffs, asynchronous updates, delivery reviews, dependency management, structured feedback, and blocker resolution.
· (20%) Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Platform Evolution: Support product strategy, multi-quarter roadmaps, operating models, and prioritized backlogs for ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise, approved LLM APIs, Codex, Claude Code, and related tools. Monitor adoption, active usage, onboarding completion, satisfaction, support quality, license utilization, platform performance, and costs; recommend product, budget, license, and process improvements. Communicate product status, decisions, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership.
· Perform other duties and contribute to related initiatives as assigned. Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, business, information systems, or a related field required
3 years of experience in product management, technical product ownership, platform operations, or a related field, including experience supporting enterprise SaaS, AI, API, developer-platform, or technical-enablement products.
Working knowledge of enterprise LLM products and APIs, including ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude Enterprise, Codex, Claude Code, or comparable platforms; product lifecycle and backlog practices; access, provisioning, and support workflows; prompt and model concepts; adoption and enablement methods; usage governance, cost controls, and responsible AI principles.

The Opportunity
As Product Manager - Merchant Experience, you will own the discovery, definition, and delivery of Xplor 's self-serve merchant portal: the place where merchants see their transactions and payouts, understand their fees, pull reports, and manage their account.

It is the everyday face of Xplor 's payments platform, and your job is to make it clear, trustworthy, and genuinely useful across global markets. This portal also acts as the internal platform our own teams use to support and configure those merchants.
You will sit at the intersection of product craft, payments, and data - turning information owned by the billing, payout, and financials teams into an experience that answers a merchant's most important questions at a glance: have I been paid, what did it cost me, and is my account set up the way I need? You will partner closely with design and research, and with the upstream teams whose data you surface.

Merchant Portal Strategy & Roadmap
Own and evolve the strategy and roadmap for Xplor 's self-serve merchant portal across global markets.
Define a vision for a merchant experience that is clear, trustworthy, and reduces the need to contact support.

At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops.
Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day .
We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.
We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.
We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.
In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.
We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.
This role is technical, but you won't be writing the code
You'll design API surfaces, debate OAuth and webhook patterns, and hold your own with senior engineers and external partner teams. The engineers write the code. Your job is to read it when needed, sketch API designs, argue technical trade-offs, and make sure what we ship is well architected. An engineering background, or serious hands-on coding experience, is what gets you that credibility.
Location & work mode
Berlin-based, minimum 3 days a week in-office, up to 2 days optional home office. We build better in the same room. Decisions happen faster, products ship faster, and the team stays sharper. EU work permit required.

Own integrations, the public API, and webhooks end-to-end: strategy, spec, build, launch, measure
Build the tools that turn our AI agents from clever responders into systems that close loops: agent to CRM, agent to appointment, agent to handover, agent to custom workflow
Stay close to customers and partners every week, in direct calls, by talking to CS, sales, and BD, and by digging into the data yourself
Embed with 4 to 6 engineers, set the metric, and own whether it moves
Treat the public API and webhooks as a product, with proper DX, docs, and a real roadmap
Make integration setup something a customer completes in minutes, alone, without a CSM walking them through it
Own quality. Engineers test as they build, you give the final go before anything ships
Own the launch and the awareness that follows. There is no product marketing team. You drive positioning, the in-product moments, and the keynote for the big launches, with marketing and sales behind you
Work across squads with the AI and Core PMs on the surfaces that touch each other

A track record of shipping things people actually use
Engineering background or strong hands-on coding experience

Fluent in OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries, and API versioning. Tool-calling and function-calling patterns a strong plus
Shameless customer obsession
Extreme clarity in writing and thinking
Speed without sloppiness
Low ego and a builder's instinct

About Sapio Sciences
Sapio Sciences is on a mission to accelerate scientific discovery and high-throughput clinical and diagnostic services. We bring together scientists, engineers, and industry specialists to build a unified lab informatics platform that helps organisations move faster, work smarter, and generate deeper insight from their data.
Artificial intelligence is central to how we innovate and operate. Within our platform, AI enhances how laboratories structure, interpret, and act on scientific data. Across our business, we apply AI thoughtfully to improve efficiency, scalability, and decision-making. It is not an add-on or future ambition. It is embedded in how we build, deliver, and continuously improve.
Our platform unifies ELN, LIMS, and scientific data management within a highly configurable environment. Scientists, laboratory professionals, and bioinformaticians rely on Sapio to manage end-to-end laboratory operations, from instrument integration and experiment setup to sample management, data analysis, and reporting. We design solutions that are powerful yet practical, enabling teams to focus on science rather than systems.
Working at Sapio
Our EMBRACE values guide how we work and grow together. We take ownership of our outcomes, collaborate openly across functions and geographies, and remain curious about how science and technology can evolve. We are accountable to each other and to our customers, and we measure our success by the real-world impact our platform enables.
Working at Sapio means being part of a lean, growth-focused team where ownership is expected and progress matters. We value colleagues who are motivated by impact and comfortable operating in an evolving environment.
At Sapio, you will work alongside people who care deeply about advancing drug discovery and improving laboratory operations worldwide. Ideas are encouraged, initiative is recognised, and professional growth is supported. As a scale-up, we move with pace and purpose, balancing innovation with responsibility.
We partner with laboratories around the world, from emerging biotech companies to global pharmaceutical and diagnostics organisations, who trust Sapio to deliver intelligent, science-aware solutions that support discovery, development, and diagnostics.

You will own the narrative around how our products solve real scientific and operational challenges, translating deep domain knowledge of ELN, LIMS, and CMC workflows into compelling demonstrations, positioning, and messaging that resonates with buyers, users, and partners.
You will report directly into our VP of Product, and work in close collaboration with the executive leadership team, including our CEO. You will operate as a senior and trusted voice, capable of engaging confidently at the executive level — both internally and with our most strategic customers.

This is a remote-first role. We are open to candidates based in the US (East Coast preferred) or the UK. There is an expectation to travel periodically — to meet with the leadership team, to join key customer engagements, and to represent Sapio at industry events. Our teams are spread across the US and the UK, with offices in York, PA, Fort Lauderdale, and London.

Own the outward-facing product narrative — developing positioning, messaging frameworks, and demo strategies that clearly articulate the value of Sapio’s platform across ELN, LIMS, and CMC workflows.
Lead and deliver high-impact solution presentations to prospective customers, partners, and at industry events, tailoring content to audience — from bench scientists to C-suite executives.

Proven experience in a product management or product marketing role within a life sciences software company, with a clear external and customer-facing orientation.
Deep knowledge of ELN and LIMS products — you must be able to speak credibly about these platforms with scientists, lab managers, and IT stakeholders.
Solid understanding of CMC processes, with experience in or exposure to biologics and the biotech/pharma development pipeline strongly preferred.

Track record of delivering high-quality product demonstrations that move deals forward and build customer confidence.

Customer-first mindset — naturally curious about how scientists and laboratory professionals work, and motivated by solving their real problems.

Able to manage competing priorities across product, sales, and marketing workstreams without losing quality or focus.

Hypofriend is a next-generation online mortgage advisor using proprietary technology to find customers the best mortgage possible and give holistic financial advice.
Unlike other mortgage advisors or brokers, we use financial insights to guide our customers. By joining us, you will be able to tap into these insights and be part of our path to transform the industry. We provide customers with tools that help them navigate the entire home buying process, from making buying decisions and give advice on the next steps to build wealth in Germany.
As Product Manager you own a slice of that machine end-to-end: the internal platform our advisors and operations team run on, and the AI and automation that make the mortgage process faster and less manual. You will work closely with engineering, design, advisors, and the founders.
Tasks
Own your product area end-to-end — from problem discovery and prioritisation to spec, launch, and measurement.
Build for our advisors and ops team. Improve the CRM, advisory and application workflows, document handling, and lender submission so advisors spend their time advising, not administrating.
Ship AI and automation into the mortgage journey — document extraction and verification, AI-assisted advisory prep, decision support, and agentic workflows — with clear guardrails for accuracy and compliance.
Connect the dots across the funnel. Understand how the customer-facing product, advisor tooling, and lender/partner integrations affect each other, and make trade-offs across them.
Learn the business deeply enough to find the levers. Understand our advice and sales principles, how the market works, and how advisors, banks and agents actually move a case forward. Use that to spot where the business loses value — drop-offs, rework, waiting time — and where a product change unblocks it. A roadmap here is a set of bets on levers, not a wish list of features.
Define success with numbers. Set metrics per initiative (conversion, time-to-offer, advisor capacity per case, automation rate, error rate), instrument them, and report honestly on outcomes.
Write clear specs and keep delivery moving. Groom the backlog, run rituals, unblock engineers, and make the call when scope has to be cut.
Work within a regulated domain. Partner with compliance and our lending partners so what we ship holds up under German mortgage regulation.

2–4 years in product management, ideally on a product with real operational complexity (fintech, marketplace, internal tooling, or workflow automation).
Comfort with numbers and data — you can write your own SQL queries or analyses rather than waiting for someone else.
A practical grasp of what today's AI models can and cannot be trusted with, and how to design around that.
A solid UX foundation — you understand how interface and interaction design shape behaviour, and you can design flows that guide advisors and the CSM team towards the right action instead of just exposing more fields and buttons.
Strong written communication and the ability to make complex financial mechanics feel simple.
Structured, self-directed, and comfortable in a small team where you own the outcome, not just the ticket.
Fluent English. German is a strong plus (our lenders, contracts, and regulation are German).
Interest in mortgages, real estate, or personal finance — the domain rewards people who go deep.

Experience with process automation, document AI, or LLM-based product features in production.
Background in lending, insurance, or another regulated financial product.
Some technical fluency — you can read an API contract and discuss architecture trade-offs with engineers.

Mission
At Hypatos , we develop a platform for building and delivering vertical AI Agents that automate document-heavy back-office workflows across core enterprise processes such as Purchase-toPay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), and Record-to-Report (R2R).

In large enterprises, business support teams still process huge volumes of transactions manually — from sales orders and contracts to invoices, payments, and order confirmations.

Our AI Agents change that: they extract, classify, validate, and route transactions automatically and automate complex business decisions, reducing the need for manual intervention in mission-critical workflows.
We are looking for a Product Manager to strengthen our product team and help shape the evolution of our AI Agent Studio — the core environment where enterprise users build, configure, review, operate and talk to AI Agents through our AI Agent Builder and Human-in the-Loop (HITL) interfaces.
This is a hands-on product role at the intersection of enterprise workflows, AI agents, and user experience. You will help shape products that redefine how enterprise teams use AI — not as aside feature, but as the core of the product experience.

As part of the Product team, you will take ownership of initiatives within the AI Agent Studio, working closely with Product Leadership, Engineering, AI, Design, and Go-to-Market teams.

You will translate product strategy, customer needs, and technical opportunities into well-specified, well-executed product increments — from discovery and specification to delivery and adoption.

Drive product initiatives within the AI Agent Studio: Own selected areas across the AI Agent Builder and HITL interfaces, helping shape how enterprise users build, operate, and scale AI Agents.
Translate user and business needs into product capabilities: Understand how customers configure agents for different transaction types, how reviewers work in the HITL interface, and what business teams need to trust AI automation in mission-critical workflows. Turn these insights into clear product decisions.
Manage product execution end-to-end: Define requirements, write specs and user stories, use AI to build product designs, manage the backlog, and drive delivery in close collaboration with Engineering and Customer Success, and Delivery teams.
Work hands-on with customers and stakeholders: Gather feedback, analyze usage, validate assumptions, and feed learnings back into the product continuously.
Support adoption and enablement: Help bring new capabilities successfully to market by contributing to documentation, release communication, enablement, and internal/external readiness

User-Centric Mindset & Execution: You think in workflows and usability, drive topics forward proactively, and are highly organized when managing multiple initiatives at once.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce .
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Our Product team builds and scales Toptal’s platform and products, working closely with our Operations and Engineering teams to support the organization’s growth. We embrace a data-focused approach to ensure each initiative on our product roadmap delivers a meaningful impact on our business and users. Our innovative technology platform enables us to deliver on-demand talent, without losing a human touch.
Are you a customer-centric Senior Product Manager with a proven track record of taking ownership and delivering results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? We’re looking for a self-starting Senior Product Manager to drive innovation at Toptal by building and scaling AI-driven products that expand the breadth and depth of our product and service offering.
As a Senior Product Manager, you will lead a team of engineers while working cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, and other Product Managers to define, build, and launch mission-critical initiatives built on Toptal’s AI platform.

We need someone to drive end-to-end product discovery and delivery, using user research, data, and cross-functional collaboration to identify new opportunities and deliver impactful solutions. If you have a knack for building high-quality, extremely impactful products, we want you on our team!
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Own and lead all aspects of an established agile team, including backlog grooming, prioritization, and cross-functional coordination, with a focus on delivering AI-driven product capabilities.

About Chili Piper
Chili Piper is a B2B SaaS company that helps GTM teams turn inbound leads into qualified meetings - instantly. Our Demand Conversion Platform makes it easier for buyers and sellers to connect fast, without the usual friction in the funnel.
We’re a fully remote, global team that loves building solutions that truly help our customers, moving fast, and having fun while creating something meaningful. We’re growing quickly and aiming big!
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Orchestrator, Chili Piper's GTM Control Layer.
Internally, we think of this role as a Product Market Fitter. This is not a traditional roadmap management role. It is a product leadership role for someone who loves building complex, enterprise-grade products and has the judgment to turn customer and market evidence into focused product bets that drive real adoption and business impact.
Orchestrator listens for signals across Chili Piper and external tools, decides what should happen next, and takes the action itself. That includes catching a form abandonment, a no-show, a missed meeting, or a cold chat, checking ICP fit, account ownership, intent history, and CRM state, then firing the right next step: enrolling a sequence in Salesloft, Outreach, or Gong Engage, notifying a rep, rescheduling a meeting, or sending a booking link.
You will own the full arc of a product bet: target customer, first audience, market and customer evidence, problem definition, intended outcome, value, viability, priority, success metrics, first adoption trigger, usage learning, and business outcome.
You will own the solution concept, meaning what we offer and how it is offered. You will not own solution architecture, implementation, or product enablement execution. You will partner closely with a Product Designer and a Product Engineering Lead to shape solutions that are valuable, coherent, and practical to deliver.
This role requires strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to turn complex workflows, data, and customer needs into clear product direction. It is a strong fit for someone who wants to build products that solve real problems for sophisticated users and who measures success by whether customers actually adopt what gets built.

Own Orchestrator end to end, from market and customer evidence through adoption, iteration, and long-term business impact
Define the first audience for every bet and protect that focus as new requests, edge cases, and opportunities emerge
Identify the right problems to solve and turn signal detection, decisioning, and action-taking into clear product direction
Define value, viability, priority, and success metrics, including what should trigger first adoption
Monitor adoption and real usage after launch, then use what you learn to improve the product and shape what comes next
Keep signal types, decision logic, and external integrations coherent, so the system stays predictable and trustworthy as it grows
Partner with Product Design on the experience, first-use path, and product-side enablement
Partner with the Product Engineering Lead on solutions that are technically sound and practical to deliver
Prioritize ruthlessly and make clear calls when the problem is complex and the answer is not obvious
Hold a high standard for quality. You do not ship things you would not want to use yourself

Senior-level experience managing complex B2B SaaS products, with clear ownership of a product area or major initiatives
Strong product judgment, with the ability to find problems worth solving and make informed tradeoffs in ambiguous environments
Hands-on use of AI tools in day-to-day product work, with good judgment about where AI genuinely improves a product experience
The ability to simplify complexity and turn customer evidence, data, and technical constraints into clear product decisions
Deep curiosity about users and markets, and a habit of building conviction through direct evidence

A bias toward focus and shipping narrow to learn quickly
Experience working closely with Engineering, Design, and cross-functional partners in a fast-moving environment
The drive to build products that solve real problems and get used, not just shipped

Experience building or owning third-party integrations, especially with CRM, Sales Engagement, or conferencing platforms
Experience with lead routing, distribution, or assignment logic
Experience with CRM or marketing automation platforms
Experience building enterprise-grade, data-rich SaaS products
Experience building or shipping with Claude or similar products
Who this role is for
This role is best suited to someone energized by high ownership, independent judgment, and making decisions without a playbook. We give people real responsibility and a lot of room to operate, which means you will be expected to run your area, set direction, and make hard calls with imperfect information.
If you are looking for a highly directed environment with a lot of structure around what to do next, this is probably not the right fit.
How this role works
We care deeply about clear ownership and close cross-functional partnership.
The Product Market Fitter owns the target customer, problem, intended outcome, value, viability, priority, adoption, and business result
The Product Designer owns the experience and product-side enablement
The Product Designer and Product Engineering Lead jointly own solution architecture
The Product Engineering Lead owns the technical solution and delivery execution

**Product Manager/in** mit Verkauf \& Einkauf 90\-100 % (m/w/d)
----------------------------------------------------------------
Ob Sie bereits Branchenerfahrung mitbringen, spielt keine Rolle: Entscheidend sind für uns Ihr **Drive, Ihre Lernbereitschaft, Ihr Interesse an Produkten, Kunden und Märkten sowie Ihre Freude daran, gemeinsam mit anderen Lösungen zu finden.**.
### **Was ist Ihre Verantwortung?**
In dieser vielseitigen Position arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle von Product Management, Verkauf und Einkauf. Sie gestalten unser Sortiment aktiv mit, bringen Markt\- und Kundenbedürfnisse ein und unterstützen dabei, unsere Produkte laufend weiterzuentwickeln. Sie werden von einem erfahrenen Team begleitet und erhalten gleichzeitig Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen.
* Sie sind mitverantwortlich für die Sortimentsgestaltung und \-optimierung, damit wir unseren Kunden passende und überzeugende Lösungen anbieten können.
* Sie analysieren Markt\- und Kundenbedürfnisse und bringen Ideen für neue Produkte, Anpassungen oder Verbesserungen ein.
* Sie arbeiten eng mit Verkauf, Marketing, Einkauf und Lager zusammen, damit Ideen auch in der Praxis sauber umgesetzt werden.
* Sie sind Ansprechperson für spezifische Kundenanfragen, erstellen Offerten und unterstützen bei der Beratung zu unserem Produktsortiment.
* Je nach Erfahrung und Einarbeitungsphase sind Sie auch direkt in die Kundenberatung eingebunden. Der telefonische Kundenkontakt hilft Ihnen, unsere Kunden, Produkte und Abläufe und praxisnah kennenzulernen.
* Sie pflegen den Kontakt zu Kunden und Lieferanten und bauen tragfähige Beziehungen auf.
### **Das bringen Sie mit**
* Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung oder eine vergleichbare Grundlage.
* Erste Berufserfahrung ist willkommen. Wichtig sind Motivation, Lernbereitschaft und der Wille, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
* Wenn Sie bereits Erfahrung mitbringen, freuen wir uns über Ihr Wissen – ebenso wichtig ist uns aber, dass Sie offen bleiben, Neues lernen und bestehende Lösungen hinterfragen.
* Sie sind neugierig, denken mit und wollen verstehen, wie **Produkte, Kundenbedürfnisse, Verkauf und Einkauf zusammenhängen.**
* Sie arbeiten gerne im Team, sind zuverlässig und bringen eine gesunde Portion Eigeninitiative kommunizieren offen, klar und respektvoll.
* Sie gehen gerne auf Menschen zu und haben Freude am Kontakt mit Kunden und an Gartenthemen, Architektur oder technischen Produkten ist ein Plus.
* Sie verfügen über fliessende Deutschkenntnisse und **mittlere bis gute mündliche Französischkenntnisse (ab B1\)**.
### **Warum zu uns?**
* Sie erhalten eine vielseitige und selbständige Aufgabe mit Nähe zu Produkt, Markt, Verkauf und Einkauf.
* Sie werden von einem engagierten Team begleitet und können Verantwortung übernehmen.
* Wir bieten Ihnen ein dynamisches Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
* Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was Sie schon können, sondern auch, was Sie lernen und bewegen wollen.
* Sie arbeiten in einem Unternehmen mit rund 50 Jahren Geschichte, das sich laufend weiterentwickelt.

Genau diese Brücke baust du. Wir suchen keinen Prozess-Verwalter, der Tickets schiebt. Wir suchen jemanden, der explore wirklich versteht, sich für das Produkt begeistert und mit Klarheit und Konsequenz dafür sorgt, dass die richtigen Dinge in der richtigen Reihenfolge gebaut werden.
Aufgaben
Produktvision & Roadmap
Du erstellst und verantwortest das Product Backlog für explore: Pflege, Priorisierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung in enger Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung, Kunden und Entwicklungsteam.
Du übersetzt Geschäftsziele und Kundenanforderungen in klare, umsetzbare User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien, und das präzise genug für das Team und verständlich genug für alle anderen.
Du setzt klare Prioritäten und begründest sie: Was bauen wir als nächstes – und warum?
Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung eine mittelfristige Produkt-Roadmap und hältst sie am Leben.
Du durchdringst die explore-Plattform inhaltlich: Agentenlogik, Automatisierungskonzepte, Möglichkeiten und Grenzen und bringst Impulse aus dem KI-Markt direkt ins Produkt.
Team & Wissenstransfer
Du führst regelmäßige Gespräche mit Bestandskunden, verstehst ihre Arbeitsprozesse und erkennst, welche Anforderungen wirklich wichtig sind und welche nur laut.
Du übersetzt Kundenfeedback, Support-Erkenntnisse und Marktbeobachtungen in konkrete Produktentscheidungen.
Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eingehende Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass nichts verloren geht, alles bewertet wird und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar sind.
Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deiner eigenen Arbeit: zur Recherche, Dokumentation, Analyse, Priorisierung und Automatisierung.
Zusammenarbeit & Steuerung
Du arbeitest täglich eng mit unseren Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern zusammen: Sprint Planning, Refinements, Reviews; du bist dabei und bringst dich inhaltlich ein.
Du beantwortest Rückfragen des Teams schnell und verbindlich, nimmst Ergebnisse ab und stellst sicher, dass sie den definierten Akzeptanzkriterien entsprechen.
Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge gut genug, um sinnvolle Abwägungen zwischen Aufwand und Nutzen zu treffen.
Du planst Demos vor Kunden und Stakeholdern und führst diese direkt im Produkt auch selbst aus.
Qualifikation
Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Software- oder Tech-Umfeld und weißt, wie agile Produktentwicklung in der Praxis funktioniert.
Eine Zertifizierung als Product Owner ist wünschenswert, aber kein Muss.
Du hast ein solides Verständnis von Softwareentwicklung und KI-Konzepten. Ein Informatikstudium oder eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker ist wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend. Entscheidend ist, dass du mit dem Entwicklungsteam auf Augenhöhe kommunizieren kannst.
Du verstehst, wie LLMs, Agenten und Automatisierungssysteme funktionieren; nicht zwingend auf Code-Ebene, aber konzeptionell sicher genug, um Produktentscheidungen darauf zu gründen.
Du kannst gut zuhören, präzise zusammenfassen und Anforderungen so formulieren, dass sie das Team direkt umsetzen kann.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, priorisierst klar und verlierst auch bei vielen parallelen Themen nicht den Überblick.
Du kommunizierst sicher auf allen Ebenen: mit Kunden, Entwicklern und der Geschäftsführung gleichermaßen und verwendest jeweils die richtige Ansprache.
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung; Englisch ist im technischen Kontext selbstverständlich.

(Senior\-) Portfolio Manager (m/w/d) – Drohnenabwehr (C\-UAV) \- Hamburg, Deutschland
Als Portfolio Manager – C\-UAV verantworten Sie die strategische Weiterentwicklung unseres Lösungsportfolios im Bereich Drohnenabwehr. Sie agieren an der Schnittstelle zwischen Markt, Technologie, Produktentwicklung und strategischem Business Development. Ihr Fokus liegt darauf, Lösungen für die Drohnenabwehr in anspruchsvollen sicherheitsrelevanten Einsatzszenarien zu positionieren und weiterzuentwickeln.
Ihre Aufgaben
Als zentrale/\-r Ansprechpartner/\-in für Ihr Portfolio entwickeln Sie dieses strategisch und kontinuierlich weiter – mit Fokus auf Innovation, Kundenanforderungen und Marktentwicklung.
Im Team arbeiten Sie zudem mit Systems Engineers, Architekten und Experten, die Ihnen als Sparringspartner/\-innen und Experten/\-innen beratend zur Seite stehen.
Sie verantworten die fachliche Zuarbeit bei der Angebotserstellung innerhalb Ihres Portfolios und begleiten die Projektphase über den gesamten Lifecycle hinweg.
Im Rahmen Ihrer Portfolioarbeit bauen Sie einen modularen, zukunftsfähigen Baukasten auf und entwickeln diesen kontinuierlich weiter und erproben neue Technologien – eine wesentliche Grundlage für effiziente und nachhaltige Lösungen.
Sie arbeiten gemäß den Prinzipien des (Model\-Based) Systems Engineerings und unterstützen aktiv bei dessen Einführung und Umsetzung im Unternehmen.
Markt\- und Mitbewerberanalysen, Trendbeobachtung sowie die Identifikation von Kundenbedürfnissen gehören ebenso zu Ihren Aufgaben wie deren Überführung in innovative Produkt\-, Lösungs\- und Dienstleistungsentwicklungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachabteilungen.
Sie übersetzen Kundenanforderungen in markt\-, kunden\- und ertragsorientierte Angebote und Kalkulationen.
In Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft gestalten Sie die strategische Ausrichtung und Vermarktung Ihres Portfolios – stets mit Blick auf reale Kundenbedürfnisse und Use Cases.
Sie unterstützen den Vertrieb bei der Kundenansprache, übernehmen technische Präsentationen und Demonstrationen und vertreten PLATH auf Fachmessen und Kongressen – auch international.
Ihr Profil
Sie verfügen idealerweise über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts\-) Ingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im militärischen Umfeld mit, vorzugsweise mit spezifischem Domänenwissen aus dem Portfoliobereich Drohnenabwehr.
Erfahrungen im SIGINT\-Umfeld sowie Kenntnisse über die Strukturen, Prozesse und Systeme der Bundeswehr sind von Vorteil.
Sie überzeugen mit einem hohen Maß an Verhandlungsgeschick, Kundenorientierung, Durchsetzungsstärke und strategischem Denkvermögen.
Eine hohe internationale Reisebereitschaft sowie interkulturelle Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke auf allen Ebenen bringen Sie selbstverständlich mit.
Sie sind sicher im Umgang mit gängiger Software wie MS Office, und idealerweise mit SE\-/MBSE\-Tools und Methoden.
Verhandlungssichere Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse setzen wir voraus, weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind willkommen.

About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.
We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.
This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up
Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it
Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work
Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them
Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does
Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of
Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting
Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required
Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist
AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further
High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first
Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others
Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it
Backgrounds that tend to fit
Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company
MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them
Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report
Why this is interesting

You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook
Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early
Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Oula delivers maternity care built around our patients—offering comprehensive support before, during, and after pregnancy. With fewer C-sections and higher VBAC success rates, our research-backed approach is delivering better outcomes. Our team of trusted midwives, OBGYNs, and dedicated care navigators ensure our patients get the type of care they need in the moments that matter most.
Since launching in 2021, we’ve expanded to include Preconception and Miscarriage Care, Pregnancy Care, Postpartum Support, and Gynecology. We currently have 4 clinics in the tri-state area, with three new clinics opening in 2026! Come join our team of clinicians, innovators, operators, and technologists passionate about setting a new standard in maternity care.

Product Manager
Full-Time
New York, Chicago or Charlotte
Reports to VP, Central Operations
About Oula
Oula Health is a venture-backed, midwifery-led maternity and GYN care company building the next generation of women's healthcare. We partner exclusively with major health systems — including Mount Sinai, Stamford Health, and Novant Health — to embed our collaborative OB-GYN and midwifery model directly inside their networks. We're a team of ~100 people at Series B stage, with 4 clinics today and three more opening in 2026.

At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR — it integrates directly into it. Every product and engineering decision has downstream consequences for how our EHRs are configured, and every EHR configuration decision shapes what's possible on the product side. Someone has to hold both at once.
We're looking for a technically-minded Product Manager to own and evolve our core technology stack — including our EHR, patient portal, and care management platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and health system integration, serving as the internal and external subject matter expert on our EMR and the primary lead for health system EHR integrations.
You'll manage the day-to-day health of our tech stack, partnering closely with both internal teams and external health system stakeholders to ensure our systems run smoothly and our integrations deliver.

You can sit with a midwife and understand why a clinical template matters, then turn around and write a bug ticket that engineering can actually action, then build the SOP so the next market launch doesn't require you to be in the room. When things are ambiguous (and they often are), you'll lean in rather than wait for clarity.
What You'll Own
EHR Configuration & Clinical Systems
Own day-to-day management of our core tech stack: the EHR, patient portal, and care management platform
Own Athena and Epic configuration end to end: clinical templates, order sets, lab configurations, payer connectivity, and access management for clinical and ops staff
Lead EHR integration efforts as the internal and external subject matter expert — FHIR/HL7 data exchange, health system IT coordination and committed go-live timelines
Own and accelerate Epic integration timelines as we onboard additional health system partners
Maintain configuration integrity as new markets launch and care model workflows evolve
Partner with our IT team on infrastructure; own the clinical systems layer they don't touch
Product Operations & Launch
Own bug intake and prioritization from Market Operations — standardize how Engineering receives, scopes, and resolves issues and communicates status back to the field
Build structured launch toolkits and training materials so clinic teams are prepared for new feature rollouts on day one
Coordinate end-to-end launches across Product, Engineering, and Operations
Identify where AI and automation can reduce manual administrative burden in product operations workflows
Standards & Knowledge Management
Build and maintain the clinical systems SOP library so new market setup is repeatable — documented well enough that a new hire can execute without you in the room
Develop onboarding materials for clinic managers and clinical staff on EHR workflows and tooling
Drive feature parity efforts so patients and clinicians experience a consistent standard of care across markets
Data & Reporting
Build and maintain dashboards tracking feature adoption, issue resolution, and rollout health across clinics
Develop quarterly reporting for Product, leadership, and health system partners on platform performance
Ensure data infrastructure is in place to measure the impact of every feature rollout

3+ years with product operations, technical program management, or PM-adjacent work — ideally at a growth-stage digital health or services company
Strong problem-solving instincts and genuine curiosity — you like figuring out how things work and making them work better
Ease with ambiguity and a bias toward action; this role requires you to create the playbook, not execute someone else's
Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and drive aggressive timelines — ideally with client-facing or health system-facing experience
Ability to speak ‘multiple languages’ – comfort going deep on technical details while communicating clearly to non-technical audiences; you can write a bug ticket, an SOP, and a launch plan that people actually follow; hands-on EHR configuration and integration experience strongly preferred
Analytical enough to build a dashboard and identify a pattern, even if you're not a SQL expert
What Success Looks Like
In your first 90 days, you've audited our current Athena configuration, identified gaps, and have a remediation plan. You understand the bug triage process well enough to have improved it. You've met your counterparts at every health system partner and know what's coming for the next Epic integration.
At six months, new market launches have a repeatable systems and product checklist. Clinic teams know what to expect before a feature goes live. Bug resolution time is measurably faster and the field is no longer sending issues into a black hole.
At one year, the SOP library is comprehensive, clinical systems configuration is stable and documented, and you've successfully navigated at least one new health system EHR environment. The product team has a reliable partner and the ops team isn't dependent on any single person for systems knowledge.

* **Axept vernetzen**: Du erkennst Synergien innerhalb von Axept und förderst aktiv den Austausch und die Zusammenarbeit über unsere Business Units hinweg

# M365 Product Owner (a) #
## 80% - 100% | Luzern ##
Microsoft 365 ist das digitale Rückgrat der Zusammenarbeit in der kantonalen Verwaltung und in den Schulen des Kantons Luzern. Wir bauen den Betrieb dieser Konzernplattform als eigenes Team neu auf und übernehmen ihn schrittweise von einem externen Partner. Als Product Owner M365 gestaltest du diesen Aufbau von Beginn an mit und machst aus den Anforderungen der Dienststellen wirksame Lösungen.
Deine Aufgaben
* Du führst das Team-Backlog des M365-Teams: du übersetzt Anforderungen in klar geschnittene, priorisierte Backlog-Items, definierst Akzeptanzkriterien und nimmst die Ergebnisse ab.
* In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Product Manager M365 setzt du Roadmap und Prioritäten in umsetzbare Arbeitspakete um und vertrittst das Team in den SAFe-Events (PI Planning, PO-Sync, Review, Refinement).
* Du arbeitest täglich eng mit den DevOps Engineers zusammen: du klärst fachliche Fragen, räumst Abhängigkeiten und Blocker aus dem Weg und sorgst dafür, dass Betriebs- und Weiterentwicklungsthemen im Backlog richtig gewichtet sind.
* Neue Begehren wie Copilot, Power Platform oder weitere M365-Dienste bringst du gemeinsam mit den Governance-, Security- und Datenschutzverantwortlichen nachvollziehbar und dokumentiert zur Freigabe.
* Du arbeitest aktiv am Aufbau des neuen M365-Teams mit und bringst agile Arbeitsweisen, eine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und einen starken Ownership-Gedanken ein.
Dein Profil
* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung (FA, HF, FH oder Universität).
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Umfeld moderner Arbeitsplatz- und Kollaborationslösungen, idealerweise in einem skalierten agilen Setup (SAFe). Du arbeitest selbstorganisiert, proaktiv und übernimmst Verantwortung über den gesamten Lebenszyklus deiner Produkte.
* Fundierte technische Kenntnisse der Microsoft-365-Plattform (Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Power Platform): du kennst Administration und Governance-Funktionen, weisst um Möglichkeiten und Grenzen und verfolgst aktuelle Entwicklungen wie Copilot aktiv.
* Verständnis für moderne Betriebsmodelle: DevOps, Automatisierung und Configuration as Code im M365-Kontext.
* Erfahrung in der öffentlichen Verwaltung oder einem regulierten Umfeld von Vorteil; Datenschutz und Governance verstehst du als Qualitätsmerkmal, nicht als Bremse.
* Du analysierst und priorisierst Anforderungen strukturiert, führst unterschiedliche Stakeholder zu tragfähigen Lösungen und bleibst verbindlich, auch wenn Interessen kollidieren.
* Kommunikationsstärke, vernetztes Denken sowie eine ausgeprägte Kunden- und Dienstleistungsorientierung runden dein Profil ab.
